name: CC0 chili salmon bowl — repeat intake test
provenance: Repeat test of the already-used promc/reconstruction-scenes chili-salmon-bowl CC0 source (51 photos and supplied COLMAP model). Public test scene; no customer submission or new customer run.

name: CC0 chili salmon bowl — floater-reduction pass (30k iters)
provenance: Same 51-photo promc/reconstruction-scenes chili-salmon-bowl CC0 source and COLMAP model as the original trained scene, re-trained with one parameter change: ns-train splatfacto --max-num-iterations raised from 7000 to 30000 (the nerfstudio/3D-Gaussian-Splatting-paper standard default), to let the densification/opacity-reset pruning schedule run to completion instead of stopping early. Public CC0 test scene; no customer submission.
quality_note: Floater-count proxy (statistical-outlier-removal on visible splats, k=16NN, median+6*MAD threshold) dropped from 80630/258496 total vertices (31.4% of visible) on the original 7k-iteration scene to 45063/232589 total vertices (19.7% of visible) on this scene -- a 44% reduction in absolute floater-candidate splat count. Still has floaters; not a complete fix.
